_comment: Curated snapshot of real, stable public data.gov dataset metadata for offline use in Labs 7.2/7.3. Mirrors the CKAN package_search result shape (result.results[]). The live tool (search_datasets) tries catalog.data.gov first and falls back to this file so labs run behind government proxies. Public data only — no PII, no proprietary content.

results.name: air-quality-annual-summary
results.title: Air Quality Annual Summary
results.notes: Annual summary statistics of ambient air pollutant concentrations (ozone, PM2.5, PM10, NO2, SO2, CO) measured at EPA monitoring sites nationwide. Includes site coordinates, pollutant standard, and completeness indicators.

results.name: cdc-fluview-ilinet
results.title: CDC FluView: ILINet Influenza-Like Illness Surveillance
results.notes: Weekly outpatient influenza-like illness (ILI) surveillance data reported through the U.S. Outpatient Influenza-like Illness Surveillance Network (ILINet), by state and HHS region. Used for seasonal influenza situational awareness.

organization.title: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

results.name: college-scorecard
results.title: College Scorecard
results.notes: Institution-level data on cost, graduation rates, median student debt, and post-enrollment earnings for U.S. postsecondary institutions. Supports transparency in higher-education outcomes.

results.name: medicare-provider-utilization
results.title: Medicare Provider Utilization and Payment Data
results.notes: Services and procedures provided to Medicare beneficiaries by physicians and other healthcare professionals, including utilization, payment, and submitted charges organized by provider and service.

results.name: fema-disaster-declarations
results.title: FEMA Disaster Declarations Summary
results.notes: Summary of all federally declared disasters since 1953, including declaration date, incident type (hurricane, flood, wildfire, severe storm), state, and designated counties. Supports emergency-management planning and resource allocation.

results.name: usaspending-federal-awards
results.title: USAspending Federal Award Data
results.notes: Government-wide record of federal contract, grant, loan, and direct-payment awards, including recipient, awarding agency, amount, and place of performance. Primary source for federal spending transparency.
